purpose: Admit learned and hybrid representations as serious rivals without giving prediction accuracy semantic sovereignty.

data_roles.development: time/source-disjoint development data; tuning allowed only here
data_roles.temporal_holdout: later or earlier period never used for representation tuning

allowed: fine-tuned encoder for frozen proxy tasks
forbidden: semantic naming of dimensions from correlation alone
period-by-period retraining counted as frozen transport
source label leakage into evaluation target
post-hoc latent rotation selected on holdout outcomes
global winner claim from one proxy metric
required_outputs: R6 decision pseudometric to competing lanes

R5_HYBRID.form: learned state + selected R2 typed constraints + R6 authority/abstention gate
R5_HYBRID.rule: A typed constraint is admitted only if its own authority is established on the relevant case; unknown fields cannot be hallucinated into hard constraints.

temporal_competition.frozen_lane: train once on development slice; no parameter updates in later temporal/source holdouts
temporal_competition.adaptive_lane: updates allowed but each update must retain ancestry, alignment map, adaptation cost, and before/after R6 decision surface
temporal_competition.no_free_retraining: adaptive performance is reported separately from frozen transport
